description: This file implements linear interpolation algorithms and associated utility functions used in a firmware project, including binary searches, interpolations, and testing functions.

classes.name: FastInterpolation
classes.description: A class for performing linear interpolation between two points with initialization methods and a method to get interpolated values.

methods.name: needInterpolationLogging
methods.description: Returns whether interpolation logging is needed.

methods.name: interpolateMsg
methods.description: Performs linear interpolation given two points and an interpolation key, with optional message.

methods.name: interpolateClamped
methods.description: Performs linear interpolation with clamping at the endpoints.

methods.name: findIndex
methods.description: Binary search to find the highest index with array[i] >= value.

methods.name: findIndex2
methods.description: Alternative binary search implementation assuming array is sorted and size is a power of two.

methods.name: ensureArrayIsAscending
methods.description: Checks and warns if an array is not sorted in ascending order.

methods.name: findIndexMsg
methods.description: Binary search returning index where array[i] >= value with message-based context.

methods.name: interpolate2d
methods.description: Performs a 1D table lookup with linear interpolation between table points.

methods.name: setCurveValue
methods.description: Sets a value in a correction curve at a specified key.

methods.name: initInterpolation
methods.description: Initializes the interpolation module with a shared logger.
